icon.description:
Badge icon to display.

When #icon is set, #displayField is ignored.

**NOTE**: This is a `Font Awesome 6 Pro` icon.

displayField.description:
Entity field to display in the badge.

Use when you want to display a number in a badge instead of an icon.

**NOTE**: Whatever field is read from the entity, it will only show the first character, but if is a number
          it will show `0-9` or `9+` if the number is greater than 9.

fieldName.description: Used together with #condition to determine if the badge should be displayed.

condition.description:
Javascript action (expression) to perform on the state information (`Entity.properties[<entityValue>]`).
The output of the action is expected to be boolean. If not condition is provided, it will assume `fieldName`
is a boolean.

**NOTE**: The `entityValue` is the value of the field specified in #fieldName.

**Example**

```json
{
...
"displayField": "openAlerts",
"fieldName": "displayOpenAlertsBadge",
"action": "displayOpenAlertsBadge === true"
...
}
```

On this example the badge will only be displayed if the `displayOpenAlertsBadge` is `true`.
And the field `openAlerts` will be displayed on the badge.

title: Configuration for a badge to be displayed for a Marker on the map.
